blocks.text: MARAWI CITY — Two visual and performance artists from Cagayan de Oro turned non-verbal storytelling into a powerful cultural dialogue, proudly waving the Philippine flag at an international art festival held from November 2 to 8 in Taiwan. Acclaimed veteran performance artist Nicolas Aca Jr. and emerging artist Alejo Tugonon, both representing Capitol University, took center stage at the Myriad Images-12 Live Art Festival in Tainan City. The global gathering brought together practitioners from around the world to explore body politics, immersive methodologies, and cultural exchange through live performance.
